subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is.

**Option (1) 'IL - FI':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24594af7675f02145fd4c2fbfcb6868f3ae1553813ad2750d1f201d4c32bdda4.png] 

**Option (2) 'MJ - DF':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf5e01e9d678343fd56ae8d0ac17b42d9f3c8d580e6e2cace9d9472a53cd1df8.png] 

**Option (3) 'NQ - KN':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8b4e75413f9a8813932bc46718eb906e4b396830869a98fa5c0ab29a665ba30.png] 

**Option (4) 'MP - JM':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a7044f033ece8135901a25a8e6642569b882b9c709b953e237ad94b2c064267.png] 

Thus, option 2 'MJ - DF' is odd one.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
